title: Dynamic Gated Cross-Modal Fusion with Sarcastic-aware Contrastive Regularization for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.19942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal sarcasm detection aims to identify sarcastic intent from multimodal content, where inconsistencies between literal meaning and contextual cues often signal irony. This task has attracted increasing research attention. However, accurate detection remains challenging due to instance-dependent modality contributions and misleading semantic consistency, where surface-level alignment masks underlying contradictory intent. translated_title: 基于动态门控跨模态融合与讽刺感知对比正则化的多模态讽刺检测
translated_abstract: 多模态讽刺检测旨在从多模态内容中识别讽刺意图，其中字面意义与语境线索之间的不一致通常暗示着反讽。该任务已引起越来越多的研究关注。然而，由于实例依赖的模态贡献和误导性的语义一致性（表面对齐掩盖了潜在的矛盾意图），准确检测仍然具有挑战性。现有方法通常依赖固定的融合策略，并将讽刺视为通用的跨模态不匹配，限制了其捕捉细微讽刺线索和实例特定模态交互的能力。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的MSD框架，该框架集成了动态门控跨模态融合与讽刺感知对比正则化（SaCR）。具体来说，一个双向门控交互模块执行跨模态特征过滤，并自适应地校准文本和视觉贡献。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合动态门控跨模态融合和讽刺感知对比正则化的新框架，以解决多模态讽刺检测中固定融合策略和表面语义一致性问题，从而更精准地捕捉实例特定的讽刺线索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework integrating dynamic gated cross-modal fusion with sarcastic-aware contrastive regularization to address fixed fusion strategies and misleading semantic consistency in multimodal sarcasm detection, enabling more precise capture of instance-specific sarcastic cues.
